fit_reason: Private owner selling a complete ice boat (sail-powered boat) listed in boats by owner; it is a whole vessel we could detail.
findings: Orange and white fiberglass body looks clean and glossy in both photos
Graphics and number decals on the hull sides appear crisp and unfaded
Orange-painted runner plank and frame look fresh with no visible chalking
Upholstered seat in the cockpit appears clean
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Slicer ice boat. The orange and white body already looks sharp and glossy in the photos. If you'd like a quick wash and wax before showing it, we come to you and can freshen up the body and frame. Would you like a quote?
